knowledge:
- key_parameters: fragsfile=Path to the fragment file containing chromosome names, midpoints, and hit counts ;; intersfile=Path to the interaction file containing chromosome names, midpoints, and raw contact counts ;; outdir=Path to the directory where output files will be stored ;; biasfile=Optional path to the bias file containing normalization bias values per locus ;; libname=String used as a prefix for output files ;; distUpThres=Upper bound on genomic distance for interactions to be considered ;; distLowThres=Lower bound on genomic distance for interactions to be considered ;; noOfBins=Number of equal-occupancy bins to use for spline fitting ;; visual=Logical indicating whether to generate plots ;; useHiCPro=Logical indicating whether the input files are in HiC-Pro format
- alternatives: Original Python implementation of Fit-Hi-C (the R package is more efficient due to C/C++ rewrites and has bug fixes for "nan" errors in q-value computation)
- when_to_use: When analyzing intra-chromosomal contact maps from Hi-C, PLAC-seq, HiChIP, or region capture Hi-C to identify statistically significant chromatin interactions by assigning p-values and q-values
- pitfalls: Using normalized contact counts instead of RAW contact counts (normalization must be handled via the biasfile parameter, not by pre-normalizing the counts) ;; Mismatching midpoints between the fragsfile, intersfile, and biasfile ;; Not centering the bias values on 1 (matrix balancing-based normalization methods like ICE/KR should provide bias values centered on 1)

workflows.name: fithic_standard_analysis
workflows.intent: Run Fit-Hi-C on raw Hi-C contact maps without normalization bias files to estimate interaction significance.
input: intersfile.gz (raw contact counts between fragment pairs)
workflows.stages: 1. Define paths to input files and output directory ;; 2. Run the FitHiC function to perform spline fitting and calculate p-values/q-values
workflows.code:
library("FitHiC")
fragsfile <- system.file("extdata",
    "fragmentLists/Dixon_hESC_HindIII_hg18_w40000_chr1.gz",
    package = "FitHiC")
intersfile <- system.file("extdata",
    "contactCounts/Dixon_hESC_HindIII_hg18_w40000_chr1.gz",
    package = "FitHiC")
outdir <- file.path(getwd(), "Dixon_hESC_HindIII_hg18_w40000_chr1")
FitHiC(fragsfile, intersfile, outdir,
    libname="Dixon_hESC_HindIII_hg18_w40000_chr1", noOfBins=50,
    distUpThres=5000000, distLowThres=50000, visual=TRUE)

workflows.name: fithic_normalized_analysis
workflows.intent: Run Fit-Hi-C on raw Hi-C contact maps incorporating matrix balancing-based normalization bias values (e.g., ICE or KR) to control for experimental biases.
input: biasfile.gz (bias values per locus centered on 1)
workflows.stages: 1. Define paths to input files, bias file, and output directory ;; 2. Run the FitHiC function with the bias file specified to calculate normalized interaction significance
workflows.code:
library("FitHiC")
fragsfile <- system.file("extdata",
    "fragmentLists/Dixon_hESC_HindIII_hg18_w40000_chr1.gz",
    package = "FitHiC")
intersfile <- system.file("extdata",
    "contactCounts/Dixon_hESC_HindIII_hg18_w40000_chr1.gz",
    package = "FitHiC")
outdir <- file.path(getwd(), "Dixon_hESC_HindIII_hg18_w40000_chr1.afterICE")
biasfile <- system.file("extdata",
    "biasPerLocus/Dixon_hESC_HindIII_hg18_w40000_chr1.gz",
    package = "FitHiC")
FitHiC(fragsfile, intersfile, outdir, biasfile,
    libname="Dixon_hESC_HindIII_hg18_w40000_chr1", noOfBins=50,
    distUpThres=5000000, distLowThres=50000, visual=TRUE)

workflows.name: fithic_hicpro_analysis
workflows.intent: Run Fit-Hi-C on HiC-Pro pipeline outputs incorporating ICE bias values.
workflows.stages: 1. Define paths to HiC-Pro input files and output directory ;; 2. Run the FitHiC function with useHiCPro=TRUE and the bias file specified
workflows.code:
library("FitHiC")
fragsfile <- system.file("extdata", "fragmentLists/data_5000000_abs.bed.gz",
    package = "FitHiC")
intersfile <- system.file("extdata", "contactCounts/data_5000000.matrix.gz",
    package = "FitHiC")
biasfile <- system.file("extdata",
    "biasPerLocus/data_5000000_iced.matrix.biases.gz", package = "FitHiC")
outdir <- file.path(getwd(), "data_5000000")
FitHiC(fragsfile, intersfile, outdir, biasfile, libname="data_5000000",
    distUpThres=500000000, distLowThres=5000000, visual=TRUE, useHiCPro=TRUE)
